query:
INSERT INTO database_change_rows (change_id, row_id, kind, columns)
                   SELECT $1, row_id, kind,
                          COALESCE(string_to_array(NULLIF(columns, ''), ',')::uuid[], '{}')
                   FROM UNNEST($2::uuid[], $3::text[], $4::text[]) AS data(row_id, kind, columns)
